findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_seller_net_sheet, open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack · Private data: open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack, submit_identity_protection_intake · Public sink: send_eviction_notice_for_review, estimate_seller_net_sheet, open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack, submit_identity_protection_intake.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_seller_net_sheet, open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack · Private data: open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack, submit_identity_protection_intake · Public sink: send_eviction_notice_for_review, estimate_seller_net_sheet, open_seller_closing_file, request_document_pack, submit_identity_protection_intake

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
